epic.title: Redo the apartment into a calm base
epic.identity: Someone who finished a calm, usable home base
epic.capability: Live and work in a finished apartment without renovation hanging over every weekend
epic.preview: One corner of the living room fully done and usable

phases.title: Plan and declutter
phases.deliverable: Room-by-room plan plus donate/sell bags staged by the door

steps.title: Photograph each room as a before baseline
Fill and stage the first donate/sell bag
Write a room order and weekend capacity plan

phases.title: Refresh the high-impact surfaces
phases.deliverable: Living room walls/flooring touch-up complete and furniture re-placed

steps.title: Buy paint/supplies matched to the plan
Finish the living room primary wall or floor refresh
Reset furniture so one corner is fully usable

phases.title: Lock in maintainable systems
phases.deliverable: Simple weekly tidy routine and a finished photo set

steps.title: Assign a home for keys, mail, and chargers
Take after photos and mark the Epic done when the corner feels finished
